metadata.title: MedOrbits FAQs
metadata.description: Expanded frequently asked questions shown on the website. Answers provide general guidance and direct users to official sources for decisions.

dataRules: id must be unique and use the faq- prefix.
category must be one of allowedValues.category.
sortOrder must be a positive integer; lower values display first.
relatedCourseIds and relatedExamIds, when set, must reference existing records.
Answers must not promise admission, employment, funding or any particular outcome.
Answers must not state specific dates, fees or eligibility rules; point to official sources instead.
The active field controls display only.
FAQs are general guidance and do not replace current official notices, regulations, contracts or professional advice.
Do not ask users to share passwords, one-time codes or unnecessary sensitive personal information through support channels.

faqs.question: How do I search for information on MedOrbits?
faqs.answer: Use the search bar with a course name, institution, examination, document, scholarship or career topic. Review the result details and follow official links for decisions or applications.

faqs.question: How can I tell whether information is current?
faqs.answer: Check the record's source and the relevant institution or authority's latest notice. If a source or verification date is not provided, treat the information as unverified and confirm it before acting.

faqs.question: How do I ask for help with a listing?
faqs.answer: Use the contact or support options published on MedOrbits. Include the page or record name and describe the issue, but do not send passwords, one-time codes or unnecessary identity documents.

faqs.question: What should I do if I find incorrect information?
faqs.answer: Cross-check the information with the relevant official source, then report the record and the specific discrepancy through the website's support channel. Do not rely on a disputed detail until it is checked.

faqs.question: Are third-party links controlled by MedOrbits?
faqs.answer: A link may lead to an external institution or service. Review the destination's domain and privacy terms before sharing information; MedOrbits cannot guarantee the availability or policies of external sites.

faqs.question: How do I choose a suitable course?
faqs.answer: Consider your interests, academic background, eligibility, costs, location and career goals. Compare course content and outcomes, and verify programme details with official institutions.

faqs.question: How can I check a course's eligibility requirements?
faqs.answer: Open the institution's official programme page and the current admission notice. Requirements can vary by institution, applicant category and intake, so do not rely on a general catalogue entry alone.

faqs.question: How do I confirm a course's duration?
faqs.answer: Check the current official curriculum or programme page. Duration may vary by qualification, institution, internship structure or applicable regulations.

faqs.question: How can I confirm whether a course is online or on campus?
faqs.answer: Check the institution's official delivery-mode information and confirm whether any practical, laboratory, clinical or in-person requirements apply.

faqs.question: How do I check whether a qualification is recognised?
faqs.answer: Check the relevant official regulator and the institution's current recognition information for the exact programme, campus and mode of study. Recognition of an institution does not automatically confirm recognition of every programme.

faqs.question: How do I verify a college or university?
faqs.answer: Check recognition, accreditation and programme details with the relevant official regulator or institution. Confirm the exact campus and programme, not only the institution name.

faqs.question: Are private colleges automatically recognised?
faqs.answer: No. Do not infer recognition from public or private ownership. Verify the institution and the specific programme with the competent official authority.

faqs.question: Where should I confirm institution fees?
faqs.answer: Use the institution's official fee notice or written fee schedule for the relevant programme and intake. Confirm what is included, payment deadlines, refund rules and any additional charges.

faqs.question: Should I rely only on an admission agent?
faqs.answer: No. Treat an agent's statement as guidance and independently verify eligibility, recognition, fees, deadlines and offers with the institution or official admission authority.

faqs.question: How do I understand an admission process?
faqs.answer: Read the current official admission notice from start to finish. Identify eligibility, application steps, required documents, selection method, deadlines, fees, counselling or interview stages and the official contact for questions.

faqs.question: Does direct admission mean admission is guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. The phrase 'direct admission' does not establish eligibility or guarantee a seat. Confirm the institution's lawful admission route, selection conditions and written offer directly with the institution.

faqs.question: What is counselling in admissions?
faqs.answer: Counselling is a process used by some admission systems to register candidates, collect preferences, allocate seats or guide joining. The exact stages and rules depend on the official authority and current cycle.

faqs.question: Does a seat allotment letter complete admission?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Read the allotment letter and official instructions for reporting, document verification, fee payment and acceptance steps. Follow only the instructions applicable to your allotment.

faqs.question: What does a waitlist or provisional offer mean?
faqs.answer: It generally indicates that a final outcome or further step may remain pending, but the exact meaning depends on the issuing institution. Read the official communication and follow its stated instructions.

faqs.question: How should I check an application deadline?
faqs.answer: Use the latest official notice or application portal for the exact programme and intake. Check for revised notices and time-zone details; do not rely solely on third-party summaries.

faqs.question: Can I apply to more than one institution?
faqs.answer: Policies vary by institution, examination and counselling system. Check whether applications, seat acceptance, deposits or simultaneous registrations have restrictions before proceeding.

faqs.question: How do I check an admission or application refund?
faqs.answer: Read the official refund and cancellation policy before paying. Keep payment receipts and written communications, and contact the institution or authority through its published official channel if terms are unclear.

faqs.question: How can I tell whether an exam is for admission or licensing?
faqs.answer: Check the exam authority's official description and purpose. Admission tests support selection into a programme; licensing assessments relate to permission or registration to practise. Do not treat one as a substitute for the other.

faqs.question: Where can I find exam dates?
faqs.answer: Check the official examination authority's current-cycle notice and updates. Dates in a catalogue may be incomplete or outdated unless they are linked to a current official source.

faqs.question: How do I register for an entrance examination?
faqs.answer: Follow the official examination portal's current instructions. Confirm the application window, eligibility, required information, payment terms and correction process before submitting.

faqs.question: Where do I get an exam admit card?
faqs.answer: Use the official examination portal or the instructions issued by the conducting authority. Avoid unofficial download pages and never share your login credentials or one-time codes.

faqs.question: How do I verify an exam result or scorecard?
faqs.answer: Check the official examination authority's result portal and notice. Use the official instructions to retrieve or authenticate the result; a third-party listing is not proof of a score or rank.

faqs.question: How can I confirm the examination mode?
faqs.answer: Read the current official information bulletin. Do not assume that an exam is computer-based or pen-and-paper based because of a previous year's format.

faqs.question: Which documents should I prepare for admission?
faqs.answer: Use the checklist in the current official admission notice for your programme, applicant category and admission route. A general document catalogue is for reference and does not make every listed document mandatory.

faqs.question: Should I carry original documents?
faqs.answer: Follow the official reporting instructions to determine whether originals, copies or digitally issued records are required and when they must be presented. Do not send originals by post unless the official process specifically instructs you to.

faqs.question: Do documents need attestation or notarisation?
faqs.answer: Requirements vary by authority, document and applicant route. Confirm the current official instructions before arranging attestation, notarisation, translation or apostille services.

faqs.question: What if my documents are not in the required language?
faqs.answer: Check whether the receiving institution or authority requires a certified translation, a particular translator or additional authentication. Do not assume that an ordinary translation will be accepted.

faqs.question: What should I do if a document upload fails?
faqs.answer: Check the official portal's file rules and try again using a supported file and stable connection. Keep a copy of the error message. Do not alter a document's content or use an unofficial service to bypass portal controls.

faqs.question: What if my name differs across documents?
faqs.answer: Check the authority's instructions for name discrepancies and accepted supporting evidence. Contact the official helpdesk before submission if the required correction or evidence is unclear.

faqs.question: How do I choose a country for study abroad?
faqs.answer: Compare programme availability, recognition, total cost, language, student support, visa rules and post-study options. Verify current details with official institutions and government sources for your situation.

faqs.question: How do I verify a foreign university or qualification?
faqs.answer: Check the destination country's official recognition resources and the relevant regulator in the country where you may later study or practise. Confirm the exact institution, campus, qualification and delivery mode.

faqs.question: Does an admission offer guarantee a student visa?
faqs.answer: No. Visa decisions are made by the relevant government authority and depend on its current requirements and assessment. Check official immigration guidance and do not rely on an institution offer alone.

faqs.question: Which language test do I need for overseas study?
faqs.answer: Requirements vary by country, institution, programme and language of instruction. Check the official admissions page for accepted tests, score requirements and any exemptions.

faqs.question: How should I estimate the cost of studying abroad?
faqs.answer: Include tuition, housing, food, transport, insurance, travel, visa-related costs and a contingency. Use official fee schedules and current government or institutional guidance; costs can change by location and intake.

faqs.question: How can I avoid study-abroad scams?
faqs.answer: Verify institutions, agents and payment instructions independently. Be cautious of guaranteed visas, guaranteed admission, pressure to pay immediately or requests to send money to personal accounts. Use official contact details to confirm offers.

faqs.question: Are scholarships guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. Eligibility, award amounts, deadlines and selection conditions depend on the scholarship provider. Apply through the official channel and verify whether an award covers tuition, living costs or only part of the expense.

faqs.question: How do I find suitable scholarships?
faqs.answer: Start with official government, institution and scholarship-provider pages. Check eligibility, eligible courses and countries, required documents, application dates, renewal conditions and whether the award is paid to the student or institution.

faqs.question: How should I compare education loans?
faqs.answer: Compare the lender's official terms, interest structure, fees, repayment start, co-borrower requirements, collateral conditions and consequences of missed payments. Read the agreement and seek qualified advice if you do not understand a term.

faqs.question: How can I check whether a fee waiver is available?
faqs.answer: Review the official institution or scheme policy and confirm the qualifying conditions, application process and supporting documents. Do not assume a waiver is available until the provider confirms it.

faqs.question: Does MedOrbits guarantee employment?
faqs.answer: No. Career information and support do not guarantee employment, salary, placement or professional registration. Verify job offers and qualification requirements with the employer and relevant regulator.

faqs.question: Will my qualification let me practise in another country?
faqs.answer: Not automatically. Professional registration and licensing rules depend on the destination jurisdiction, qualification, training and applicant route. Confirm requirements with the relevant official regulator before making plans.

faqs.question: Can I use a resume builder for every application?
faqs.answer: A resume builder can help organise information, but adapt the final document to the employer, role and application instructions. Ensure all details are accurate and never include credentials or experience you do not have.

faqs.question: How can I identify a suspicious job offer?
faqs.answer: Be cautious if an offer requires upfront payment, asks for passwords or one-time codes, uses unverifiable contact details or promises unrealistic outcomes. Verify the employer through its official website or published contact channel.

faqs.question: How do I check whether an internship is suitable?
faqs.answer: Review the role, duties, supervision, learning outcomes, compensation terms and any academic or professional requirements. Verify the organisation and get the important terms in writing before accepting.

faqs.question: What personal information should I share on the website?
faqs.answer: Provide only information needed for the feature you are using. Never share passwords, one-time codes, full payment-card credentials or unrelated sensitive documents in a public form or support message.

faqs.question: Should I share an OTP with support staff?
faqs.answer: No. Do not share one-time passwords or account verification codes with anyone. Enter them only in the trusted sign-in or verification flow you initiated.

faqs.question: What should I do if I cannot access my account?
faqs.answer: Use the website's official account recovery process. Check the registered contact details and official support options; never send your password or verification code to another person.

faqs.question: How can I verify a payment request?
faqs.answer: Confirm the amount, payee and purpose through the official website or institution before paying. Use the stated official payment route and keep the receipt. Do not pay an individual account based only on an unsolicited message.

faqs.question: How do I check subscription terms?
faqs.answer: Read the subscription page and checkout summary before confirming. Check the price, billing interval, renewal, cancellation, refund terms and features included; save the confirmation for your records.

faqs.question: What if a page or tool does not work on my device?
faqs.answer: Try updating the browser, reloading the page and checking your connection. If the issue persists, contact support with the page address, device/browser details and a description of what happened; omit passwords and private documents.

faqs.question: How can I tell whether an admission message is official?
faqs.answer: Compare the sender and details with the institution's official website or portal. If the message asks for urgent payment or sensitive information, confirm independently using contact details published by the institution.

faqs.question: Can I edit an exam application after submitting it?
faqs.answer: Only if the examination authority permits changes under its current rules. Check the official correction-window notice and review any limits or fees before making changes.

faqs.question: Are digital documents always accepted?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Check the authority's instructions for accepted digital records, issuer verification and any requirement to present originals or certified copies.

faqs.question: Can international students work while studying?
faqs.answer: Work permissions depend on the destination country's current immigration rules and the conditions attached to the student's status. Consult official government guidance before accepting work.

faqs.question: How can I avoid scholarship or loan scams?
faqs.answer: Use official provider and lender channels. Be suspicious of guaranteed awards, upfront release fees, requests for passwords or OTPs, and payment to personal accounts. Verify the programme independently before sharing documents or paying.
